name: Leo
label: YouTube Premium user weighing a switch
who: I use Spotify for music, podcasts and playlists, and I already pay for YouTube Premium, which includes a music player ([30],[33]). I'm weighing YouTube Music against Spotify because the recommendations and price increases make Spotify feel less worth it.
value_for_money: Says YouTube Premium already includes a music player, so Spotify makes less sense to pay for ([30],[33]); cites a price increase and a sister paying 12.99 euro alone ([33]); says Spotify is not worth it with AI music and worse service ([31]).
loyalty: Stays for Jam and listening with friends ([35]) and for access they consider worth the money ([37]); would move to YouTube Music, which they can get through YouTube Premium ([30],[33]), if the same recommendations keep repeating ([38]).
pain_points: Recommendations repeat what they already listen to ([38],[13])
likes: Jam lets friends add to the queue ([35])
Music, podcasts and audiobooks in one app ([2],[11])
reasons_to_stay: They say Jam and listening with long-distance friends are the main reasons they stay ([35]), and that Spotify works for the music access they get for the price ([37]). They still note YouTube Music is better in some ways ([22]).
tone: Short, conversational and a bit exasperated, with lots of rhetorical asides.
